title: New Feature Alert ! Online MarkepPlace App ( Mystery Egg Shop Simulator Dev Log)
author: BrkRocigamer
selftext:
In this simulation game , we aimed to make users sell their items through other steam users. Also buy the ones that they need for their collection ! You can check the seller nick name and even sell an item to a friend that is missing an item ! All these will be with the in-game money and through your in-game phone with the in-game money !!!!

This has never been tried before in shop keeper games before as far as I know so we are super hyped about the idea ! You can set your own price if the rare item is not available in the market and create your own vendor in the online market app section. Here is how it works , you can check from the video. I will share how you make purchases in the next video. This feature will be available in the full version of the game.   
Please dont forget to try the prologue and wishlist the game !  
Thanks  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4492070/Mystery\_Egg\_Shop\_Simulator\_\_Prologue/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4492070/Mystery_Egg_Shop_Simulator__Prologue/)

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: This looks so cool! What ai tools were used? Were you already familiar with coding or was this vibe coded?

replies.author: BrkRocigamer
replies.body:
Hey ! Thanks a lot ! Super excited to see the selling online feature in action by the players, I hope people use it / love it a lot and we see an economy growing through it.   
The server side was made with Opus 4.8 , the rest of the code was hand written 😄
